note: Because city boundaries follow a standardized global approach rather than national definitions, estimates may differ from official country figures.
title: Share of urban population who live in the largest city
subtitle: Estimated share of urban population (the sum of [cities](#dod:cities-degurba)  and [towns and suburbs](#dod:towns-degurba)) living in the largest city. [City](#dod:cities-degurba) boundaries are defined using a consistent global approach based on satellite imagery and population data.
